column_description: A BIGSERIAL PK for system monitoring info (e.g., 56789).
An INTEGER counting total API requests in a window (e.g., 45230).
An INTEGER total of API errors (e.g., 123).
A REAL capturing average API latency (e.g., 150.2).
An enum (WSState_enum) describing websocket state (Connected, Disconnected).
A SMALLINT for remaining requests before rate limit (e.g., 75).
A VARCHAR(60) short note on last system update (e.g., 'AutoScale triggered').
A VARCHAR(60) sequence/version code for real-time updates (e.g., 'seq-0012').
A DECIMAL(8,2) typical order execution time in ms or s (e.g., '12.50').
An INTEGER tracking queued tasks or orders (e.g., 45).
A REAL approximating internal market impact (e.g., 1.2).
A REAL approximating net price improvement (e.g., 0.4).
A BIGINT FK to AnalyticsIndicators(AnalyticsIndicatorsNode), linking to advanced analytics.
